definition.en: The Shanwei urban core around its municipal government and the Pinqing Lake waterfront, shown in a 24 km landscape window.
definition.zh-CN: 以汕尾市政府所在的城区为中心，展示品清湖沿岸主城及周边24公里地形。
definition.zh-TW: 以汕尾市政府所在的城區為中心，展示品清湖沿岸主城及周邊24公里地形。

441500.verification: OSM named government office way 573917854, centre of its building nodes; official planning document confirms Chengqu is the municipal seat. Original way retained in admin-shanwei-osm.json.

definition.en: An island close-up centred on Wuqiu Lighthouse on Daqiu, including the settlement and nearby coast; this is not an urban district.
definition.zh-CN: 以大坵岛上的乌坵灯塔为焦点，近看聚落与周边海岸；这里采用岛屿近景，并非城市建成区。
definition.zh-TW: 以大坵島上的烏坵燈塔為焦點，近看聚落與周邊海岸；這裡採用島嶼近景，並非城市建成區。

TWN:Wuqiu.verification: Point independently falls within the original NLSC land polygon (zero distance to polygon).

definition.en: A close-up of Taiping Island and its facilities, centred on the island location reported by the environmental authority; there is no conventional urban core.
definition.zh-CN: 以环境主管机关公开的岛上位置为焦点，近看太平岛及其设施；这里没有通常意义上的主城区。
definition.zh-TW: 以環境主管機關公開的島上位置為焦點，近看太平島及其設施；這裡沒有通常意義上的主城區。

TWN:Taiping.verification: Government environmental release publishes 10°22′38″N / 114°21′59″E; converted exactly to decimal degrees. Point lies within NLSC land polygon (zero distance).
